curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When military programming fails to bury a fallen soldier's humanity, which resurfaces first: his past loyalties or the lethal instincts engineered into his present?
curatedMovie.description: Revived decades after falling in the Vietnam War, an American soldier is re-engineered as a UniSol cybernetic warrior—until a glitch in his memory wipe triggers flashbacks to the past he was never meant to remember.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Exciting, fast-moving sci-fi action anchored by military thriller tension, offering an engaging and accessible watch.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Roland Emmerich delivers a fast-paced sci-fi thriller combining high-tech military action with the tense, personal unraveling of a bio-engineered soldier's programmed identity.
